a: pyproject.toml is the modern standard for Python project metadata and build.
pip is standard; Poetry/uv improve dependency workflows.
Isolate project dependencies from the system Python.
pip install -e . links the package for active development.
Define CLI scripts in package metadata.
Wheels are built artifacts; sdists are source distributions.
Declare supported Python versions in packaging metadata.
Lock files freeze exact versions for reproducible installs.
Namespace packages split a logical package across distributions.
Build and upload with twine/trusted publishing; protect API tokens.
